item.title: Visible-Light-Driven Dearomatization via Electrocyclic Ring Expansion for Solar Energy Storage

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in 9-aryl acridine N-oxides that undergo visible-light (470 nm) dearomative ring expansion to metastable 1,2-oxazepines for molecular solar thermal storage. Significance: energy densities up to 0.54 MJ/kg, red-shifted absorption, solid-state lifetimes up to 1.4 years, tunable half-lives, and a substituent strategy suppressing decomposition—establishing ring expansion as a viable MOST design principle.
